summary: Recover declared managed targets missing from accepted base

delivery.outcome: An upgrade may restore a base-declared managed target that is proven absent only through an exact-path, exact-base-lock-digest declaration consumed once
nonGoals: Do not automatically forgive missing managed files
Do not overwrite any target bytes present in the accepted base
Do not weaken head lock or managed payload hash verification
Do not release a new standard version in this ticket

architecture.decision: Extend standardAdoption with optional managedTargetRestorations entries whose exact path and baseDigest must match a base-managed lock entry absent from the accepted Git tree and be consumed exactly once
architecture.rollback: Revert the contract and validator change; every base-declared but absent managed target returns to fail-closed GOV-SYNC-001
